chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Umar ibn Hanzala, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There are five signs before the rising of Al-Qa'im: The Scream, and the Sufyani, and the Sinkings (of the earth), and the killing of the Pure Soul, and the Yamani.'
So I said, 'May I be sacrificed for you, if someone from your Household comes out before these signs, shall we come out with him?' He said: 'No'.
So when it was the next morning, I recited this Verse: 'If We please, We should send down upon them a sign from the heaven so that their necks should stoop to it'.
I said to him, 'Is this the Scream?' He said, 'If that were so, then the necks of the enemies of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, would have stooped in humility.'
ai.seo_question: What are the five signs before the rise of the Mahdi and what is the meaning of the Scream?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies five definitive signs preceding the Mahdi's rise, clarifying a common exegetical point regarding the 'Scream' (Al-Sayhah) by linking it to Quran 26:4. He distinguishes this specific divine phenomenon from general submission, emphasizing that it uniquely forces the necks of Allah's enemies into humility, thereby validating its role as a unique eschatological marker rather than a universal event.

en.hubeali: H 14931 – Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al-Hakam, from Abu Ayyub Al-Khazaz, from Umar Bin Hanzala who said:

I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘There are five signs before the rising of Al-Qaimasws – The scream, and the Sufyani, and the sinking (of the earth), and the killing of the pure soul (Al-Nafs Al-Zakkiyya) and Al-Yamany’.

So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>, if someone from your<sup>asws</sup> Household comes out (in revolt) before these signs, shall we come out (revolt) with him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
So when it was the next morning, I recited this Verse: “[26:4] If We please, We should send down upon them a sign from the heaven so that their necks should stoop to it”.
I said, ‘Is this the scream?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If that was, then the necks of the enemies of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would stoop down in humility’.
en.sarwar: 484. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzaal, from Abu Jameela, from Muhammad Bin Ali Al-Halby who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (a.s.) saying: ‘The differing of the Clan of Abbas is from the inevitable, and the Call is from the inevitable, and the coming out of Al-Qaim (a.s.) is from the inevitable’. I said, ‘And How would be the Call?’
He (a.s.) said: ‘A Caller will Call out from the sky at the beginning of the day: ‘Indeed! Ali (a.s.) and his (a.s.) Shites, they are the winners’.
He (a.s.) said: ‘And a Caller will Call out at the end of the day: ‘Indeed! Usman and his Shites, they are the winners’.
